## Public beta: the public install is now the front door

PyFFmpegCore {{ tag }} is the documentation and evidence fix-forward for the
first public beta. The package remains a safe, explainable FFmpeg task runner:
it checks local capabilities, previews exact plans, applies explicit execution
policy, probes outputs, and writes privacy-redacted receipts.

### Problems this release addresses

- Every primary install path now uses the exact public PyPI release instead of a source revision.
- The README and docs link the signed release, exact workflow run, checksums, and both PyPI attestations.
- A real 63-second terminal cast and accessible transcript prove public install, `doctor`, synthetic media, explained plan, progress, output facts, and receipt validation.
- The recording script now remains inside its required 60–90 second evidence window on fast machines.

### Reproduce the demonstrated workflows

- [63-second public terminal proof](https://othmaneblial.github.io/pyffmpegcore/terminal-demo/)
- [Preserve every video, audio, subtitle, attachment, and data stream](https://othmaneblial.github.io/pyffmpegcore/recipes/preserve-streams/)
- [Web-compatible editor/camera video](https://othmaneblial.github.io/pyffmpegcore/recipes/web-video/)
- [Fit a video under an exact upload limit](https://othmaneblial.github.io/pyffmpegcore/recipes/exact-size/)
